comment: Each oscillator's frequency is C4 times two to the power of the shared pitch plus its own CV over 5 plus its own tune knob (chainsaw.cpp:94), so the tune knob is an octave either way and the tune CV an octave per 5V. The shape mix is built at chainsaw.cpp:108 to :114: turning the knob negative brings in the phase to the fourth power, turning it positive brings in the ninth root, and the middle is the plain ramp. Align is a level, not an edge: it holds the phases together for as long as it is on (chainsaw.cpp:124 to :128).
